## Effect ops

Every `op` an `effects` list may name. Each takes a spec dict; the common fields are `objects` (a selector), `player` (a player spec) and `amount` (a value expression). *Records `as`* marks the ops that write a binding when given an `as` name; the loader refuses `as` on any other. Defined under [Effect ops](card-dsl.md#effect-ops).

| `for_each_player` | Control flow |  | Run effects once per player of a spec. | ["Each opponent sacrifices…" — a loop over players](card-dsl-cookbook.md#each-opponent-sacrifices--a-loop-over-players) |
| `if` | Control flow |  | Run `then` effects if a condition holds, else `else`. | [Effect ops](card-dsl.md#effect-ops) |
| `join_forces` | Control flow | yes | Each player may pay into one shared X. | [Join forces — the one cost the whole table pays](card-dsl-cookbook.md#join-forces--the-one-cost-the-whole-table-pays) |
| `may` | Control flow | yes | Optional effects, with an optional `pay`; `as` records who said yes. | [may's as, and except on a player spec](card-dsl-cookbook.md#mays-as-and-except-on-a-player-spec) |
| `noop` | Control flow |  | Do nothing (a placeholder for text with no effect). | [Effect ops](card-dsl.md#effect-ops) |
| `repeat` | Control flow |  | Run effects N times. | [Effect ops](card-dsl.md#effect-ops) |
| `repeat_while` | Control flow |  | Run effects while a condition holds. | [Effect ops](card-dsl.md#effect-ops) |
| `snapshot` | Control flow | yes | Remember what objects are now, for a later value or spec. | [sacrifice's snapshot — what the creature had](card-dsl.md#sacrifices-snapshot--what-the-creature-had) |

## Selectors

Every key a selector ("which objects") may carry. All present keys must match. Defined under [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `any_of` | A union of whole selectors: any one may match. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `any_types` | Any one of these card types is enough. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `attached` | Attached to the named object ("self", a binding, a target). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `attacked_this_turn` | Attacked this turn (read after combat). | [Which creatures attacked this turn, and how many](card-dsl.md#which-creatures-attacked-this-turn-and-how-many) |
| `attacking` | Is attacking. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `attacking_player` | Attacking this player (`you`/`opponent`/`any`), not their planeswalkers. | ["Attacks you" is not "attacks you and/or your planeswalkers"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#attacks-you-is-not-attacks-you-andor-your-planeswalkers) |
| `base_power` | A comparison on base power (layer 7a/7b). | [power / toughness — a derived characteristic, read at a fixed layer](card-dsl.md#power--toughness--a-derived-characteristic-read-at-a-fixed-layer) |
| `base_toughness` | A comparison on base toughness. | [power / toughness — a derived characteristic, read at a fixed layer](card-dsl.md#power--toughness--a-derived-characteristic-read-at-a-fixed-layer) |
| `binding` | Exactly the objects a named `as` recorded. | [Recording what an op consumed or produced — "this way", "the token"](card-dsl.md#recording-what-an-op-consumed-or-produced--this-way-the-token) |
| `blocked` | Is (or is not) blocked by anything. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `blocking` | Is blocking. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `chooser` | Who picks: `controller`, `owner` or `none`. | [chooser — when somebody else picks the mode](card-dsl-cookbook.md#chooser--when-somebody-else-picks-the-mode) |
| `colors` | Has one of these colors. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `controller` | Controlled by `you`/`opponent`/`any` or a player spec. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `count` | How many: an int or value, `all`, or `any`. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `created_with` | Tokens created with the named permanent. | [Tokens "created with this creature" — created_with](card-dsl.md#tokens-created-with-this-creature--created_with) |
| `damaged` | Was dealt damage this turn. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `damaged_by` | Was dealt damage this turn by the named object. | ["…dealt damage by this creature this turn"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#dealt-damage-by-this-creature-this-turn) |
| `drawn_this_turn` | Cards drawn this turn (hand only). | [Cards in a hand drawn this turn](card-dsl.md#cards-in-a-hand-drawn-this-turn) |
| `encoded_by` | Cards encoded on the named creature (cipher). | [Cipher — the third direction an exile link can point](card-dsl-cookbook.md#cipher--the-third-direction-an-exile-link-can-point) |
| `entered_this_turn` | Entered the battlefield this turn. | [entered_this_turn — the same fact asked of one permanent](card-dsl.md#entered_this_turn--the-same-fact-asked-of-one-permanent) |
| `exclude_binding` | Everything except the objects under a binding ("each other"). | [Recording what an op consumed or produced — "this way", "the token"](card-dsl.md#recording-what-an-op-consumed-or-produced--this-way-the-token) |
| `exclude_self` | Not this permanent ("other"). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `exiled_with` | Exiled with the named source. | [Targeting a card in exile](card-dsl-cookbook.md#targeting-a-card-in-exile) |
| `extreme` | The greatest/least of power, toughness or mana value in the pool. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `has_counters` | Has counters (of a kind) on it. | [has_counters — "with counters on them"](card-dsl.md#has_counters--with-counters-on-them) |
| `haunted_by` | Haunted by the named card. | [Haunt — the exile link pointing the other way](card-dsl-cookbook.md#haunt--the-exile-link-pointing-the-other-way) |
| `is_commander` | Is (or is not) a commander. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `is_token` | Is (or is not) a token. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `keywords` | Has all of these keywords. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `mana_cost` | Printed mana cost is one of these. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `mana_value` | A comparison on mana value. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `min_colors` | Has at least N colors ("multicolored"). | ["Multicolored" — min_colors](card-dsl.md#multicolored--min_colors) |
| `modified` | Is modified (equipped, enchanted by you, or has counters). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `name` | Named exactly this, or the name under a binding. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `not_colors` | Has none of these colors. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `not_keywords` | Has none of these keywords. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `not_name` | Not named this (a list for two or more). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `not_subtypes` | Has none of these subtypes. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `not_supertypes` | Has none of these supertypes ("nonbasic"). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `not_types` | Has none of these card types ("noncreature"). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `object_kind` | Restrict to cards, tokens, spells or abilities. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `optional` | Exactly N, or none at all ("you may"). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `owner` | Owned by `you`/`opponent`/`any` or a player spec. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `paid_by` | A spell paid with mana from the named source. | ["When that mana is spent to cast…"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#when-that-mana-is-spent-to-cast) |
| `phased_out_with` | Phased out by the named source. | ["…phases out until this enchantment leaves the battlefield"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#phases-out-until-this-enchantment-leaves-the-battlefield) |
| `player` | Whose zone to walk (for hand, library, graveyard, exile). | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `power` | A comparison on live power. | [power / toughness — a derived characteristic, read at a fixed layer](card-dsl.md#power--toughness--a-derived-characteristic-read-at-a-fixed-layer) |
| `random` | Pick at random rather than by choice. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `self_only` | This permanent only. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `shares_a_color_with` | Shares a color with the named object. | [Describing objects relative to another object](card-dsl.md#describing-objects-relative-to-another-object) |
| `shares_a_creature_type_with` | Shares a creature type with the named object. | ["…that shares a creature type with this creature"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#that-shares-a-creature-type-with-this-creature) |
| `shares_a_name_with` | Has the same name as the named object. | [Describing objects relative to another object](card-dsl.md#describing-objects-relative-to-another-object) |
| `shares_a_type_with` | Shares a card type with the named object. | [Describing objects relative to another object](card-dsl.md#describing-objects-relative-to-another-object) |
| `shares_a_type_with_commander` | Shares a creature type with your commander. | ["…that shares a creature type with your commander"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#that-shares-a-creature-type-with-your-commander) |
| `shares_permanent_type_with` | Shares a permanent type with the named object. | [Describing objects relative to another object](card-dsl.md#describing-objects-relative-to-another-object) |
| `subtypes` | Has one of these subtypes. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `supertypes` | Has one of these supertypes. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `tapped` | Is (or is not) tapped. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `target` | The objects a target id chose. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `toughness` | A comparison on live toughness. | [power / toughness — a derived characteristic, read at a fixed layer](card-dsl.md#power--toughness--a-derived-characteristic-read-at-a-fixed-layer) |
| `types` | Has all of these card types. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |
| `union` | One pool made of several zones' selectors. | [One choice across two zones — union](card-dsl-cookbook.md#one-choice-across-two-zones--union) |
| `x_in_mana_cost` | Has {X} in its printed mana cost. | [A restriction that is not a name — mana_value, x_in_mana_cost](card-dsl-cookbook.md#a-restriction-that-is-not-a-name--mana_value-x_in_mana_cost) |
| `zone` | Which zone to look in. | [Selectors — "which objects"](card-dsl.md#selectors--which-objects) |

## Player specs

The named player specs. The structured forms -- `{"target": …}`, `{"controller_of_target": …}`, `{"controller_of": …}`, `{"owner_of": …}`, `{"binding": …}`, `{"not": …}`, `{"attacked_by": …}` -- are described under the same heading. Defined under [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `active_player` | Whose turn it is. | [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs) |
| `all` | Every player (a tally over the whole table). | [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs) |
| `controller` | The controller of the object in question. | [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs) |
| `each_opponent` | Every opponent. | [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs) |
| `each_player` | Every player. | [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs) |
| `enchanted_player` | The player the source Aura is attached to. | [An Aura that enchants a player](card-dsl-cookbook.md#an-aura-that-enchants-a-player) |
| `gift_recipient` | The opponent promised a gift as this spell was cast. | [Gift — a promise made to one opponent, for nothing](card-dsl-cookbook.md#gift--a-promise-made-to-one-opponent-for-nothing) |
| `opponent` | An opponent (each of them, at a pod). | [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs) |
| `you` | The ability's controller. | [Player specs](card-dsl.md#player-specs) |

## Values

Every head a value expression may have, anywhere a number is expected. Defined under [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `additional_paid` | Whether (or how often) an additional cost was paid. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `attacked_this_turn` | 1 if the player attacked this turn, else 0 (raid). | [Which creatures attacked this turn, and how many](card-dsl.md#which-creatures-attacked-this-turn-and-how-many) |
| `attackers_this_turn` | How many creatures the player attacked with this turn. | [Which creatures attacked this turn, and how many](card-dsl.md#which-creatures-attacked-this-turn-and-how-many) |
| `binding` | A number a trigger or an `as` carried. | [Recording what an op consumed or produced — "this way", "the token"](card-dsl.md#recording-what-an-op-consumed-or-produced--this-way-the-token) |
| `cards_drawn_this_turn` | Cards the player drew this turn. | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `cards_from_graveyard_this_turn` | Cards that left the player's graveyard this turn. | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `cards_in_hand` | Cards in the player's hand. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `cards_to_graveyard_this_turn` | Cards put into any graveyard this turn (gravestorm). | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `colors_of_mana_spent` | Colors of mana spent to cast this (sunburst, converge). | [Counting the mana that was actually spent](card-dsl.md#counting-the-mana-that-was-actually-spent) |
| `combats_this_turn` | Which combat phase of the turn this is. | [Which combat phase of the turn this is](card-dsl.md#which-combat-phase-of-the-turn-this-is) |
| `commander_color_identity` | Colors in your commander's color identity. | [Commander-identity mana — "any color in your commander's color identity"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#commander-identity-mana--any-color-in-your-commanders-color-identity) |
| `const` | A literal number. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `count` | How many objects a selector finds. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `counters_had` | Counters of a kind the dying creature had. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `counters_on` | Counters of a kind on the objects a selector finds. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `creatures_died_this_turn` | Creatures that died this turn (morbid). | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `creatures_you_control` | Creatures the player controls. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `damage_taken_this_turn` | Damage the player was dealt this turn (bloodthirst). | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `distinct` | Distinct values of a quality among a pool (domain, coven). | [Counting different values rather than objects](card-dsl.md#counting-different-values-rather-than-objects) |
| `extreme_value` | The greatest/least of a quality in a pool, as one number. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `greatest_discarded_by_a_player` | The greatest number of cards one player discarded this way. | [Discarding a whole hand, and reading the greatest that went](card-dsl.md#discarding-a-whole-hand-and-reading-the-greatest-that-went) |
| `half` | Half of a value, rounded `up` or `down`. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `lands_you_control` | Lands the player controls. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `life_gained_this_turn` | Life the player gained this turn. | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `life_lost_this_turn` | Life the player lost this turn (spectacle). | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `life_of` | A player's life total (summed over a plural spec). | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `loop_value` | The current item of an enclosing `for_each`. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `loyalty_activations_this_turn` | Loyalty abilities the player activated this turn. | [Counting an event rather than the board](card-dsl.md#counting-an-event-rather-than-the-board) |
| `mana_spent_of` | Mana of a color actually spent to cast this. | [mana_spent_of — what was paid, not what is printed](card-dsl.md#mana_spent_of--what-was-paid-not-what-is-printed) |
| `mana_symbols` | Pips of a color among a pool's mana costs (chroma). | [Counting mana symbols](card-dsl.md#counting-mana-symbols) |
| `mana_value_of` | Mana value of an object (summed over a pool). | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `max` | The greatest of several values. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `max_count_of` | The most objects any one player of a spec has. | [Counting one player at a time](card-dsl.md#counting-one-player-at-a-time) |
| `max_life_of` | The highest life total among a spec's players. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |

| `min_count_of` | The fewest objects any one player of a spec has. | [Counting one player at a time](card-dsl.md#counting-one-player-at-a-time) |
| `min_life_of` | The lowest life total among a spec's players. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |

| `power_had` | The power the dying creature had. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `power_of` | An object's power. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `resolutions_this_turn` | Times this ability has resolved this turn. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |

| `spells_cast_this_game` | Spells the player has cast this game, by filter. | [Counting the spells you cast, by type](card-dsl-cookbook.md#counting-the-spells-you-cast-by-type) |

| `sum` | a + b + …. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `times` | a * b. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |
| `toughness_had` | The toughness the dying creature had. | [Value expressions](card-dsl.md#value-expressions) |

## Conditions

Every head a condition may have: an effect's `if`, a trigger's intervening `condition`, a `may`'s guard. Defined under [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `all` | Every listed condition holds. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `any` | At least one listed condition holds. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `cast_during` | The phase this spell was cast in (addendum). | [Addendum — the phase a spell was cast in](card-dsl-cookbook.md#addendum--the-phase-a-spell-was-cast-in) |
| `cast_from_graveyard` | This spell was cast from a graveyard. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `cast_from_hand` | This spell was cast from hand. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `cmp` | Compare `left` and `right` values with `op`. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `combat_damage_by` | A player was dealt combat damage this turn by one of these subtypes (prowl). | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `cost_option` | Which of the tiered additional costs was paid. | [Tiered, and reading back which price was paid](card-dsl.md#tiered-and-reading-back-which-price-was-paid) |
| `entered_from` | The source entered from the named zone. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `evoked` | The source was cast with evoke. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `exists` | A selector finds at least one object. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `gift_promised` | A gift was promised as this spell was cast. | [Gift — a promise made to one opponent, for nothing](card-dsl-cookbook.md#gift--a-promise-made-to-one-opponent-for-nothing) |
| `has_city_s_blessing` | The player has the city's blessing (ascend). | [Ascend](card-dsl-cookbook.md#ascend) |
| `has_flag` | The source carries a word written by `set_flag`. | ["If this creature hasn't been exerted this turn"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#if-this-creature-hasnt-been-exerted-this-turn) |
| `has_turn_flag` | The source carries a word written by `set_turn_flag` this turn. | ["If this creature hasn't been exerted this turn"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#if-this-creature-hasnt-been-exerted-this-turn) |
| `is_active_player` | It is the given player's turn ("during their turn"). | ["During their turn" — whose turn a trigger means](card-dsl-cookbook.md#during-their-turn--whose-turn-a-trigger-means) |
| `is_monarch` | The given player is the monarch. | [The monarch](card-dsl-cookbook.md#the-monarch) |

| `kicked` | This spell was kicked. | [A permanent's own enters trigger can read it](card-dsl-cookbook.md#a-permanents-own-enters-trigger-can-read-it) |

| `of` | Which spell the cast-mode conditions ask about. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |
| `overloaded` | This spell was cast for its overload cost. | [Overload](card-dsl-cookbook.md#overload) |
| `right` | `cmp`'s right operand. | [Conditions](card-dsl.md#conditions) |

## Static effects

Every `effect` a `kind: "static"` ability may name. *Player-wide* ones take `affects_player` instead of `affects`; *grantable* ones may be handed to another permanent by a `grant_ability` static. Defined under [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities).

| Name | Player-wide | Grantable | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ability_cost_reduction` |  | yes | Activated abilities of matching permanents cost less. | [A static that discounts another permanent's activated ability](card-dsl.md#a-static-that-discounts-another-permanents-activated-ability) |

| `add_mana_on_tap` | yes |  | Whenever a matching permanent is tapped for mana, add extra mana. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `add_subtype` |  | yes | Matching permanents have an extra subtype. | ["…is the chosen type in addition to its other types"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#is-the-chosen-type-in-addition-to-its-other-types) |
| `attack_tax` |  | yes | Matching creatures can't attack unless their controller pays. | [Pricing an attack rather than forbidding it](card-dsl.md#pricing-an-attack-rather-than-forbidding-it) |
| `attacks_if_able` |  | yes | Matching creatures attack each combat if able. | [The continuous form](card-dsl-cookbook.md#the-continuous-form) |
| `black_mana_as_phyrexian` | yes |  | The player may pay life for each {B} in a cost. | [black_mana_as_phyrexian — K'rrik's "For each {B} in a cost"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#black_mana_as_phyrexian--krriks-for-each-b-in-a-cost) |

| `spell_cost_increase` |  | yes | Matching spells cost more (mana or life) to cast. | [Making other spells cost more, in life](card-dsl-cookbook.md#making-other-spells-cost-more-in-life) |
| `spell_cost_reduction` |  | yes | Matching spells cost less to cast. | [Making other spells cheaper](card-dsl-cookbook.md#making-other-spells-cheaper) |
| `spells_cant_be_countered` |  | yes | Matching spells can't be countered. | ["This spell can't be countered"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#this-spell-cant-be-countered) |
| `spend_mana_as_any_color` | yes |  | The player may spend mana as though it were any color. | [spend_mana_as_any_color — Chromatic Orrery's colour waiver](card-dsl-cookbook.md#spend_mana_as_any_color--chromatic-orrerys-colour-waiver) |
| `untap_during_each_untap_step` |  | yes | Matching permanents untap during each other player's untap step too. | [Untapping on somebody else's turn](card-dsl-cookbook.md#untapping-on-somebody-elses-turn) |
| `untap_limit` | yes |  | The player untaps at most N permanents during their untap step. | [Not untapping at all](card-dsl-cookbook.md#not-untapping-at-all) |
| `ward` |  | yes | Matching permanents have ward with a cost. | [Ward with a cost](card-dsl.md#ward-with-a-cost) |

## Grantable statics

The static effects a `grant_ability` static may hand to another permanent. Defined under [grant_ability as a static, and where the line now runs](card-dsl-cookbook.md#grant_ability-as-a-static-and-where-the-line-now-runs).

|---|---|---|

| `add_subtype` | Matching permanents have an extra subtype. | ["…is the chosen type in addition to its other types"](card-dsl-cookbook.md#is-the-chosen-type-in-addition-to-its-other-types) |
| `attack_tax` | Matching creatures can't attack unless their controller pays. | [Pricing an attack rather than forbidding it](card-dsl.md#pricing-an-attack-rather-than-forbidding-it) |
| `attacks_if_able` | Matching creatures attack each combat if able. | [The continuous form](card-dsl-cookbook.md#the-continuous-form) |
| `block_restriction` | Matching creatures can't block, or can only block under a rule. | [Block restrictions](card-dsl-cookbook.md#block-restrictions) |
| `block_tax` | Matching creatures can't block unless their controller pays. | [Pricing a block rather than forbidding it](card-dsl.md#pricing-a-block-rather-than-forbidding-it) |
| `buff` | Matching permanents get +N/+M. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |
| `cant_attack` | Matching creatures can't attack. | [Landwalk, and global attack prohibitions](card-dsl-cookbook.md#landwalk-and-global-attack-prohibitions) |

| `cant_block` | Matching creatures can't block. | [Landwalk, and global attack prohibitions](card-dsl-cookbook.md#landwalk-and-global-attack-prohibitions) |
| `cant_block_alone` | Matching creatures can't block alone. | [Can't attack or block alone](card-dsl-cookbook.md#cant-attack-or-block-alone) |

## Cost reduction

The arithmetic heads a card-level `cost_reduction`, a `spell_cost_reduction` static or an ability's `mana_reduction` may use. The filter beside them is the static filter plus the keys under *Cost-reduction filter keys* below, minus the refused ones. Defined under [Cost reduction](card-dsl-cookbook.md#cost-reduction).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `amount` | Costs N less (usually gated on a `condition`). | [An activated ability that gets cheaper](card-dsl-cookbook.md#an-activated-ability-that-gets-cheaper) |
| `count` | Costs {1} less for each object a filter finds. | [An activated ability that gets cheaper](card-dsl-cookbook.md#an-activated-ability-that-gets-cheaper) |
| `greatest_count` | …for the greatest number any one player has. | [A reduction that maximises a per-player tally](card-dsl.md#a-reduction-that-maximises-a-per-player-tally) |
| `greatest_mana_value` | …by the greatest mana value among a filter's objects. | […by the greatest mana value of a commander you own](card-dsl-cookbook.md#by-the-greatest-mana-value-of-a-commander-you-own) |
| `total_mana_value` | …by the total mana value of a filter's objects. | [A reduction that sums mana values](card-dsl.md#a-reduction-that-sums-mana-values) |
| `total_power` | …by the total power of a filter's objects. | [Cost reduction](card-dsl-cookbook.md#cost-reduction) |

## Durations

The values `playable` takes on `exile`, `look_at_top` and `grant_playable` -- how long "you may play it" lasts. Defined under [How long "you may play it" lasts](card-dsl-cookbook.md#how-long-you-may-play-it-lasts).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `this_turn` | Until this turn ends. | [How long "you may play it" lasts](card-dsl-cookbook.md#how-long-you-may-play-it-lasts) |
| `your_next_end_step` | Until your next end step begins. | [How long "you may play it" lasts](card-dsl-cookbook.md#how-long-you-may-play-it-lasts) |
| `end_of_your_next_turn` | Until the end of your next turn. | [How long "you may play it" lasts](card-dsl-cookbook.md#how-long-you-may-play-it-lasts) |
| `later_turns` | On a later turn only (plot, warp). | [Plot](card-dsl.md#plot) |
| `while_exiled` | For as long as it remains exiled. | [How long "you may play it" lasts](card-dsl-cookbook.md#how-long-you-may-play-it-lasts) |

## Decision kinds

Every question the engine can stop and ask a seat -- the `DecisionKind` enum. Not card vocabulary: a card never names one, but every `ask_*` an op makes becomes one of these on the wire.

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `priority` | A player holds priority: pass, cast, activate, play a land. | — |
| `declare_attackers` | Declare attackers. | — |
| `declare_blockers` | Declare blockers. | — |
| `mulligan` | Keep or mulligan an opening hand. | — |
| `discard_to_hand_size` | Discard down to maximum hand size at cleanup. | — |
| `choose_objects` | Choose objects from a pool (targets, searches, sacrifices). | — |
| `choose_mode` | Choose a mode. | — |
| `choose_x` | Announce X. | — |
| `may` | Yes or no. | — |
| `choose_player` | Choose a player. | — |
| `commander_zone_change` | Send a commander to the command zone, or let it go. | — |

## Static filter keys

The subset of the selector language a static's `affects` may use -- printed characteristics only, plus three relations to the static's own source. Defined under [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `any_of` | A union of whole static filters, each with its own `exclude_self`; `affects` only. | [any_of — a union of static filters](card-dsl.md#any_of--a-union-of-static-filters) |
| `any_types` | Any one of these card types is enough. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `attached` | Attached to the named object ("self", a binding, a target). | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `attached_to_host` | Attached to the static's own source ("equipped creature"). | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `attacking` | Is attacking. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `blocking` | Is blocking. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `colors` | Has one of these colors. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `controller` | Controlled by `you`/`opponent`/`any` or a player spec. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `entered_this_turn` | Entered the battlefield this turn. | [entered_this_turn — the same fact asked of one permanent](card-dsl.md#entered_this_turn--the-same-fact-asked-of-one-permanent) |
| `exclude_self` | Not this permanent ("other"). | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `has_counters` | Has counters (of a kind) on it. | [has_counters — "with counters on them"](card-dsl.md#has_counters--with-counters-on-them) |
| `is_commander` | Is (or is not) a commander. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `is_token` | Is (or is not) a token. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `keywords` | Has all of these keywords. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `mana_cost` | Printed mana cost is one of these. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `not_keywords` | Has none of these keywords. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `not_supertypes` | Has none of these supertypes ("nonbasic"). | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `not_types` | Has none of these card types ("noncreature"). | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `owner` | Owned by `you`/`opponent`/`any` or a player spec. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `paired` | Is paired (soulbond). | [Soulbond — a relationship that is not attachment](card-dsl-cookbook.md#soulbond--a-relationship-that-is-not-attachment) |
| `paired_with_source` | Paired with the static's own source. | [Soulbond — a relationship that is not attachment](card-dsl-cookbook.md#soulbond--a-relationship-that-is-not-attachment) |
| `power` | A comparison on live power. | [power / toughness — a derived characteristic, read at a fixed layer](card-dsl.md#power--toughness--a-derived-characteristic-read-at-a-fixed-layer) |
| `self_only` | This permanent only. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `subtypes` | Has one of these subtypes. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `supertypes` | Has one of these supertypes. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `tapped` | Is (or is not) tapped. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |
| `toughness` | A comparison on live toughness. | [power / toughness — a derived characteristic, read at a fixed layer](card-dsl.md#power--toughness--a-derived-characteristic-read-at-a-fixed-layer) |
| `types` | Has all of these card types. | [Static abilities](card-dsl.md#static-abilities) |

## Static conditions

What a static's "as long as …" `condition` may ask. Defined under ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `all` | Every listed condition holds. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `any` | At least one listed condition holds. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `cmp` | Compare `left` and `right` values with `op`. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `counters` | The source has (or lacks) counters of a kind. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `exists` | A selector finds at least one object. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `has_city_s_blessing` | The player has the city's blessing (ascend). | [Ascend](card-dsl-cookbook.md#ascend) |
| `is_attached` | The source is attached to something. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `is_your_turn` | It is the controller's turn. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `not` | The condition does not hold. | ["As long as…"](card-dsl.md#as-long-as) |
| `top_of_library` | The top card of a library matches a filter. | ["The top card of your library is black"](card-dsl.md#the-top-card-of-your-library-is-black) |

## Static values

The subset of the value language a static's magnitude (`power`, `amount`, …) may use. Defined under ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `const` | A literal number. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |
| `count` | How many objects a selector finds. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |
| `counters_on` | Counters of a kind on the objects a selector finds. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |
| `mana_symbols` | Pips of a color among a pool's mana costs (chroma). | [Counting mana symbols](card-dsl.md#counting-mana-symbols) |
| `max_count_of` | The most objects any one player of a spec has. | [Counting one player at a time](card-dsl.md#counting-one-player-at-a-time) |
| `max_life_of` | The highest life total among a spec's players. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |
| `min_count_of` | The fewest objects any one player of a spec has. | [Counting one player at a time](card-dsl.md#counting-one-player-at-a-time) |
| `min_life_of` | The lowest life total among a spec's players. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |
| `permanents_entered_this_turn` | How many matching permanents entered this turn. | [Which permanents entered the battlefield this turn](card-dsl.md#which-permanents-entered-the-battlefield-this-turn) |
| `starting_life_of` | The life total a player began with. | ["At least 7 life more than your starting life total"](card-dsl.md#at-least-7-life-more-than-your-starting-life-total) |
| `sum` | a + b + …. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |
| `times` | a * b. | ["+1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact"](card-dsl.md#11-for-each-charge-counter-on-this-artifact) |

Keys a cost-reduction filter accepts beyond the static filter. Refused there: `attached`, `attached_to_host`, `paired`, `paired_with_source` -- a count cannot mean anything by them. Defined under [Cost reduction](card-dsl-cookbook.md#cost-reduction).

| Name | Description | Defined in |
|---|---|---|
| `any_of` | Count an *or* of characteristics. | [A reduction that counts an or of characteristics](card-dsl.md#a-reduction-that-counts-an-or-of-characteristics) |
| `zone` | Count in a zone other than the battlefield. | [Counting filters, and the zone key](card-dsl.md#counting-filters-and-the-zone-key) |

| `miracle` | Miracle cost. | [Dredge, madness and miracle — replacements that stop to ask](card-dsl-cookbook.md#dredge-madness-and-miracle--replacements-that-stop-to-ask) |
| `graveyard_cast` | Castable from a graveyard on its own say-so. | [Casting from the graveyard](card-dsl-cookbook.md#casting-from-the-graveyard) |
| `graveyard_cost` | …and what that costs. | [Casting from the graveyard](card-dsl-cookbook.md#casting-from-the-graveyard) |
| `graveyard_cast_transformed` | Disturb: cast from the graveyard onto the back face. | [Disturb](card-dsl-cookbook.md#disturb) |
| `splice_onto` | What this card may be spliced onto. | [Splice](card-dsl-cookbook.md#splice) |
| `melds_with` | The card this one melds with. | [Meld — mutate's merged permanent, with the pair fixed by the card](card-dsl-cookbook.md#meld--mutates-merged-permanent-with-the-pair-fixed-by-the-card) |
| `melds_into` | The permanent the pair melds into. | [Meld — mutate's merged permanent, with the pair fixed by the card](card-dsl-cookbook.md#meld--mutates-merged-permanent-with-the-pair-fixed-by-the-card) |

## Effect op keys

The keys each op reads beside its `op` name are not tabulated here: that list is derived from the op's source *and* from what the shipped pool writes, so it would move with every card. `cards.authoring.packet.reference()` builds it for the authoring packet, which is where a worker reads it. See [Effect ops](card-dsl.md#effect-ops).
